best_for: 3D printer owners, with an UltiMaker or another brand, who want a free slicer with community printer profiles and plugins.

points.title: Free and open source
points.text: Cura is free and LGPL-3.0 licensed. UltiMaker's own cloud tool, Digital Factory, is a separate product.

points.title: Profiles from the community
points.text: Besides UltiMaker printers, Cura ships community-managed print profiles, and the project documents how to add your own machine.

points.title: A marketplace for extras
points.text: The UltiMaker Marketplace adds material profiles from brands and community plugins for print preparation.

points.title: Opens CAD files too
points.text: Besides mesh files, Cura lists STEP and IGES among the formats it can open.

points.title: Needs a capable graphics chip
points.text: Cura needs an OpenGL 2 graphics card, and OpenGL 4.1 for the 3D layer view, which not all Intel integrated graphics support. UltiMaker asks for 4 GB of RAM minimum, 8 GB recommended. It is 64-bit only.

points.title: Linux Flatpak is not UltiMaker's
points.text: UltiMaker offers an AppImage for Linux. The Flatpak here is listed under UltiMaker but Flathub does not mark it as verified, and it is x64 only.

points.title: Older versions on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 32 versions, all machine-wide x64 installs. macOS (Intel and Apple silicon) and Linux list only the current release.
